integrity: Reproducible exact finite certificate under the cited published global theorem; only self-review, with independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd positive factors of weight three and products of weight three only; uses Kaneko–Stoll Theorem 2.2 for the strict global product bound. Individual six products were already listed in OEIS A080025. Absence of an earlier full classification is based on inspected evidence, not proven universally.
title: Exact \(3,3,3\) binary-weight product classification
